Alexander Mitchell decreased its stake in Nexstar Media Group Inc (NXST) by 57.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scopus Asset Management Lp sold 495,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.98% with the market. The hedge fund run by Alexander Mitchell held 365,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $28.54 million, down from 860,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scopus Asset Management Lp who had been investing in Nexstar Media Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.07B market cap company. The stock increased 1.13% or $0.75 during the last trading session, reaching $67.2. About 368,500 shares traded. Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:NXST) has declined 3.18% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.73% the S&P500.
